terminals.name: control-plane
terminals.description: Arachne control-plane FastAPI web app (SQLite-backed) on http://localhost:8080. Providers are disabled and demo OTP is enabled for local development.
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && export TMADS_ENVIRONMENT=development TMADS_DATA_DIR=.tmads-data TMADS_MEDIA_DIR=.tmads-data/media TMADS_COOKIE_SECURE=false TMADS_DEMO_OTP_ENABLED=true TMADS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost,127.0.0.1,testserver,0.0.0.0 && exec uvicorn tmads_control_plane.main:create_app --factory --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
